name: mingleo
description: Convenience scripts. frontend/ and backend/ are independent apps with their own dependencies.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
